$comment: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/check-licenses.ts. An entry applies only while the installed licence string still equals `license`; bumping a package to a different licence re-fails the gate. Scopes: dev-only (never shipped), build-only (used while building, not in the output), runtime-unused (installed but no code path loads it), mislabelled-spdx (permissive licence with a non-SPDX string). Last review: 2026-10-10.

exceptions.reason: Optional native libvips binary pulled by next -> sharp for next/image optimisation. Dynamically linked, unmodified, and Tessera does not use next/image optimisation. If image optimisation is ever enabled, set images.unoptimized or re-review.
Optional wasm fallback for sharp (see @img/sharp-libvips-darwin-arm64). Never loaded on this platform and image optimisation is not used.
Dependency of eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y (eslint-config-next). Runs only during lint; nothing from it is shipped. MPL is file-level copyleft on its own files, which we do not modify.
CSS transformer bundled with vite for vitest. Used only while running tests; not part of the Next build output. Unmodified.
Native binary of lightningcss (see above). Dev-only, unmodified.

Browser-support data consumed by browserslist inside next and babel while building. The data never reaches the product UI, so no attribution is shown in the app; the attribution requirement is met by this notice and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
LICENSE file is the BSD-3-Clause text (Copyright 2014 Yahoo! Inc.); package.json uses the non-SPDX string "BSD". Transitive via @astryxdesign/core -> @stylexjs/stylex.
